ValidationRule.description: Only Team Leadership (HowTo_Decide_Ideas) can make or undo a decision: a change between Submitted or Declined and Accepted-or-later, into or out of Declined, or creating content at any status but Submitted.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT($Permission.HowTo_Decide_Ideas), OR(AND(ISNEW(), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Submitted"))), AND(NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Status__c), OR((CASE(TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Status__c)), "Submitted", 1, "Accepted", 2, "Drafting", 3, "Proofing", 4, "Production", 5, "Editing", 6, "Final Review", 7, "Published", 8, "Retired", 9, 0) >= 2) <> (CASE(TEXT(Status__c), "Submitted", 1, "Accepted", 2, "Drafting", 3, "Proofing", 4, "Production", 5, "Editing", 6, "Final Review", 7, "Published", 8, "Retired", 9, 0) >= 2), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Declined"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Declined")))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only Team Leadership can accept or decline an idea, or undo that decision.
